candidates.change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender.call to occur before resetting credit[msg.sender] to 0 (introduces reentrancy possibility and changes final state observable after withdrawAll).
Send value using transfer instead of low-level call, which reverts on failure differently and caps gas, changing observable behavior when withdrawAll completes.
Zero the stored credit before decrementing balance (order change may lead to underflow/invalid balance logic and different final state), i.e., set credit to 0 then subtract from balance.
Do not decrement balance when withdrawing (remove balance update), changing observable contract state after withdrawAll returns.
Require that callResult is false instead of true, causing revert on successful sends and changing observable outcome.
